title: Rainspire Professional Box Grater, Cheese Grater Box for Kitchen Stainless Steel with 4 Sides, Cheese and Spice Graters with Handle for Vegetables, Ginger, Potatoes, Black
description:
About this item
Durable Sharp, Stainless Steel - Made of 304 stainless steel (95%), the heavy-duty cheese grater provides rugged strength and long-lasting performance
Sharp Blades on 4 Sides - Coarse, medium, and fine grating surfaces, and slicing surface.Sharp stainless-steel shredding holes on 4 sides allow for efficient grating of a variety of foods, including cheese, vegetables, chocolate, and more
Ergonomic Comfortable Handle - the comfortable non-slip handle provides a safe, secure grip and ultimate control
Non-slip Base - Black TPE material (5%) on the base helps keep the grater securely in place while in use. Dishwasher-safe for quick cleanup
Multipurpose Versatility - The grater works well for grating cheese and hard or soft vegetables, like cucumbers, cabbage, carrots, onions, potatoes, zucchini, and more

reviews_5s:
I got this today and grated some Munster cheese for my spaghetti. I usually like cheddar cheese for spaghetti, but all I had was Munster. It is pretty soft, but the grater worked fine even for this soft Munster. \

It is solid metal with a nice handle. Works great.I had hoped to find a sturdy all-stainless stand-up grater. This is close. Cutting surfaces are very sharp, metal is hefty enough and it's larger--able to make quick work of grating cheddar, slicing cukes, etc. The handle/top part is plastic but comfortable, and there's a rubber-like base that keeps things from slipping around during use. For the price it's a solid value!This is a quality grater with sharp blades! I bought 2 different ones at the big box stores and they were junk. This ones is great!It is very wide and sturdy great for grading I would recommend it.Bought for a house warming gift for a friend. She says it's really nice. Came quickly. And good price point.★★★★★ The Coleslaw Champion: A Cheese Grater That Shreds (More Than Just Cheese)

Let me tell you about this unassuming box grater that swooped in and turned my coleslaw game into a masterpiece. Sure, it’s labeled a cheese grater, but oh, this bad boy does so much more—like turning cabbage into perfectly shredded confetti for my *famous* coleslaw recipe. (Yes, it’s famous. Well, at least at family BBQs.)

First off, the design feels solid and sturdy, like it’s ready to take on a whole head of cabbage without breaking a sweat. The handle is grippy and comfortable, so even after a marathon grating session, my hands didn’t feel like they’d gone 12 rounds with a prizefighter. It stays firmly planted on the counter, thanks to the nonslip base, which means no awkward sliding while you're mid-shred.

The stars of the show, though, are those gloriously sharp blades. Cabbage? Destroyed. Carrots? Pulverized. Cheese? Ha, like cutting through butter. It’s versatile, efficient, and dare I say… kind of cathartic to use. My coleslaw comes out so evenly shredded, it looks like it was done by a professional chef (it wasn’t).

Want to know the best part? Cleanup is surprisingly easy. A quick rinse, throw it in the dishwasher (yes, dishwasher safe!), and boom—done. Low-effort maintenance for a high-impact tool.

So, if you’re in the market for a cheese grater that secretly moonlights as the MVP of coleslaw production (and more), look no further. This humble little tool will leave you wondering how you ever lived without it. Trust me—your recipes, and your taste buds, will thank you. 🥬🧀Easy to use and super sturdyNice graterIts goodour cok loves it
